title: Jharkhand High Court designates 10 lawyers as Senior Advocates
description: The High Court of Jharkhand has designated 10 lawyers as Senior Advocates. The designations were approved by Chief Justice and other judges in a Full Court meeting held on June 17. The advocates that have been conferred the senior gown are:Jitendra S Singh Darshana Poddar Mishra Dr Hasnain Waris Prashant Pallav Amar Kumar Sinha Indrani Sen Choudhary Amit Kumar Das Rajiv Sinha Rajendra Krishna Kalyan Roy[Read Notification]
